connectorUiConfig.title: BitSight Security Events (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [BitSight](https://www.bitsight.com/) data connector provides the capability to ingest security alerts, breaches, and findings from your BitSight portfolio into Microsoft Sentinel through the BitSight REST API. The connector monitors portfolio companies for rating changes, news alerts, data breaches, and detailed security findings across Diligence, Compromised Systems, and User Behavior risk categories. Refer to the [BitSight API documentation](https://help.bitsighttech.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014888388-API-Token-Management) for more information.

sampleQueries.query:
BitSightAlerts_CL
 | where Severity in ('WARN', 'CRITICAL') and TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
 | project TimeGenerated, CompanyName, AlertType, Severity
 | order by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Get findings reported as active and severe
sampleQueries.query:
BitSightFindings_CL
 | where CurrentlyActive == true and SeverityCategory in ('MATERIAL', 'SEVERE')
 | project TimeGenerated, CompanyName, RiskVectorLabel, SeverityCategory, Severity, FirstSeen
 | order by Severity desc

instructionSteps.title: 1. Connection Management
instructionSteps.description: Manage your BitSight data stream connections

parameters.content:
## BitSight Connections

Manage multiple BitSight data stream connections. Each connection selects one or more **data streams** to ingest and assigns a **Connection Name** that is stored in the `ConnectorName` column of every ingested record.

> **Authentication**: BitSight uses HTTP Basic Authentication with your API Token.

parameters.label: Add Connection
parameters.title: Add BitSight Connection
parameters.subtitle: Configure a new BitSight data stream connection

parameters.content:
## 1. Select Data Streams

Choose which BitSight security event data types to collect for this connection. You can select multiple streams.

**Findings collect newly discovered records in daily first-seen windows.** Later changes to existing findings, including resolution or severity changes, are not collected. Retries or replayed windows can still produce duplicates; findings published after their window was processed can be missed.

options.text: Alerts - Rating changes and news events (BitSightAlerts_CL)
Breaches - Data breach events for portfolio companies (BitSightBreaches_CL)
Diligence Findings - Web, app, and network risk factors (BitSightFindings_CL)
Compromised Systems Findings - Botnet and malware activity (BitSightFindings_CL)
User Behavior Findings - Credential and employee risk activity (BitSightFindings_CL)

parameters.content:
## 3. Authentication

Provide your BitSight API Token. It authenticates requests to the BitSight REST API using HTTP Basic Authentication.

parameters.text: Enter your API token only. The connector creates the HTTP Basic Authorization header automatically.
Obtain your API Token from **Settings > Account > User Preferences > API Token** in the BitSight portal.

parameters.content:
## 4. Connection Name

Assign a unique name to identify this connection in the grid and in every ingested log record.

parameters.text: The connection name is stored in the `ConnectorName` column of every ingested record, enabling you to trace data back to this specific connection.
